title: polypodium morianum
intro: Polypodium morianum, commonly known as Chinese Polypody or Polypodium leucotomos var. morianum, is a type of fern used in traditional medicine. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium morianum are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been reported to include flavonoids such as quercetin and kaempferol, alkaloids like aristolochic acid, and phenolic acids like ferulic acid and sinapic acid.
